project_name: MekongGreen - Bản đồ số Cơ giới hóa Nông nghiệp Vùng ĐBSCL

theme_strategy.rationale: Enterprise Government Dashboard. Requires high data clarity, focus on map integration, and clean data presentation. Dark themes can muddy map visibility if not carefully controlled, so a clean light theme (#F8FAFC background) with strong blue and green accents creates trust and authority.

typography.rationale: Authority, Technical Precision, and Vietnamese Legibility.

headings.instruction: Do not use Inter. Cabinet Grotesk gives a slightly structured, authoritative look perfect for a government tech dashboard. Use tracking-tight (-0.02em).

body.instruction: Highly legible for dense data tables and map popups.

colors.primary_instruction: Xanh lá công nghệ nông nghiệp. Use for primary buttons, active successful states, and 'Đủ' status.
colors.secondary_instruction: Xanh lam Mekong. Use for Header, SideNav backgrounds, and active tab states.
colors.accent_instruction: Xanh ngọc. Focus rings, highlights, and special badges.

login_page.structure: Split 50/50 layout (h-screen, w-full). Left side: full cover image of rice field/harvester with a blue overlay (bg-[#00A3E0]/40). Right side: Login form container centered, bg-[#F8FAFC].
login_page.details: Left side MUST have an overlay so it doesn't look raw. Right side has Logo and Login form (No signup).

dashboard_shell.structure: Fixed Left SideNav + Main Content Area (calc(100vw - sidebar_width)).
dashboard_shell.sidenav: Deep dark background (e.g., #0B1120 or #00A3E0 directly if preferred, let's use deep dark #0B1120 with #00A3E0 active item background and #00A82D left border highlight). Fixed width 260px.
dashboard_shell.header: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/70, border-b border-slate-200) for breadcrumbs and user profile.

map_page.structure: Full height map area. Leaflet map takes 100% height minus header. Absolute positioned Glassmorphism Side Panel Filter (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/80, shadow-lg, rounded-xl, left 24px, top 24px). Absolute positioned Machine Status Table on the bottom or right.

component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md) with sharp inner text. Hover state must darken background. Never rely on just color.
component_instructions.cards: Neumorphic / Flat Solid strategy. bg-white, 1px border-slate-200, shadow-sm. Use sharp corners (rounded-lg maximum).
component_instructions.map_markers: Tech pin markers using Lucide React icons (e.g., Tractor, Leaf). Markers MUST change color based on the status (Sufficient, Short, Severe, No Data).
component_instructions.tables: Dense rows, left-aligned data, border-b on rows, no vertical borders. Use sticky header.
component_instructions.charts: Recharts. Use the MekongGreen theme colors for bars/lines. Remove default Recharts grid lines or make them very faint (stroke-slate-100).
component_instructions.glassmorphism: Used for map overlay panels. backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/70, border border-white/40.

pages_and_features.name: Login
pages_and_features.features: Split 50/50 layout. Left image with blue overlay. Right form with logo and login (no signup).

pages_and_features.name: Bản đồ số
pages_and_features.features: Leaflet.js OSM, 6 Mekong provinces. Map markers (Tractor/Sprout) colored by status. Glassmorphism filter panel. Machine status overview table overlay.

pages_and_features.name: Dashboard Tổng quan
pages_and_features.features: 4 KPI Cards (Total Machines, Co-ops, Ha Covered, etc.). Recharts for machine types, province distribution, density. Priority list.

pages_and_features.name: Cân đối Cung-Cầu & Cảnh báo
pages_and_features.features: Comparison table by crop stages (Làm đất, Gieo sạ, etc.). Badges for Thiếu/Đủ/Thừa. Emergency warning strip at the top.

pages_and_features.name: Quản lý HTX & Máy móc
pages_and_features.features: Admin CRUD tables with 2 tabs. Actions column. Upload Excel button.

pages_and_features.name: Báo cáo & Kết xuất
pages_and_features.features: Filter bar. 3 Report cards. Export to Excel/PDF buttons.

pages_and_features.name: Quản trị Hệ thống
pages_and_features.features: Tabs for Accounts, Categories, Quotas, Parameters, API logs.

visual_enhancers.motion: Use framer-motion for page transitions (fade in) and staggered list animations in tables. Add micro-interactions to filter pills and navigation items.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct shadows for floating map elements. Flat/no shadow for dashboard grid cards, just 1px borders.

login_left_cover.description: Combine harvester working in a golden rice field. Used on the left side of the 50/50 split login screen. REQUIRES a blue (#00A3E0) overlay at 40% opacity.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not center align text globally.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Do not use transparent background where content scrolls under it; use glassmorphism.
Build the dashboard layout with a strict grid system (col-span strategies).
Map must use 'react-leaflet' and Leaflet CSS.
Ensure high contrast for text (APCA/WCAG standards).
Use Tailwind arbitrary values carefully, prefer standard spacing scale.
technical_stack_notes: React, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI primitives, Recharts, React-Leaflet.
